about: Tuned llama-server settings per model and route, applied by `1bit serve` (docs/recipes.md). A recipe never overrides a flag already on the backend's command line or a variable already set. Every recipe carries the measurement behind it; re-measure with tools/bench.py before changing one.

recipes.why: W4A4 expert matmuls fill the matrix units better with 1024-token micro-batches; 2048 is no better.
recipes.measured: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Q4_0-H32, llama-bench pp2048 2,001 -> 2,158, pp16384 1,227 -> 1,283; decode unchanged. Dense Qwen3.8-27B-H32 is slower with it (1,838-token prompt 491-495 -> 471-473 tok/s), so dense files keep 512.

recipes.why: Stops a DFlash2 block at the first candidate the selector is less than 40% sure of: code keeps its full blocks, prose and short answers stop paying to verify guesses that fail. Listed before dflash-p-min-0, so it wins on rocm.
recipes.measured: Qwen3.8-27B-H32 + DFlash2 Q8_0 on the lean ROCm route, tools/bench.py 2 rounds, decode median code / prose / short: p-min 0 41.9 / 24.8 / 13.4, 0.2 42.0 / 25.7 / 13.7, 0.4 41.9 / 26.8 / 16.7, 0.6 39.7 / 24.1 / 15.5 tok/s.

recipes.why: A DFlash block is only worth drafting whole; the ROCm tree's default p-min of 0.75 cuts it short (upstream's default is 0).
recipes.measured: Qwen3.8-27B-H32 + DFlash2 on the lean ROCm route: mean accepted block 5.4 -> 6.7 tokens on code.
